# vastdata_compute_cluster_pods (Data Source)

Kubernetes pods in a compute cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vastdata_compute_cluster_pods" "tf_test_cluster_pods" {
  compute_cluster_name = "tf-test-cluster"
}

data "vastdata_compute_cluster_pods" "calico_system_pods" {
  compute_cluster_name = "tf-test-cluster"
  namespace            = "calico-system"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `compute_cluster_id` (Number) Compute cluster ID. Provide this or compute_cluster_name.
- `compute_cluster_name` (String) Compute cluster name. Used to look up the cluster ID when compute_cluster_id is not set.
- `deployment` (String) Filter pods by deployment name. Requires namespace.
- `namespace` (String) Filter pods by namespace.

### Read-Only

- `pods` (Attributes List) Kubernetes pods in the compute cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pods))

<a id="nestedatt--pods"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pods`

Read-Only:

- `conditions` (Attributes List) Pod status conditions reported by Kubernetes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pods--conditions))
- `created_at` (String) Pod creation timestamp.
- `ip` (String) Pod IP address.
- `name` (String) Pod name.
- `namespace` (String) Pod namespace.
- `node` (String) Node name where pod is scheduled.
- `status` (String) Pod status (Running, Pending, Failed, etc.).

<a id="nestedatt--pods--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pods.conditions`

Read-Only:

- `last_transition_time` (String) Timestamp of the condition's last transition.
- `message` (String) Human-readable message about the condition's last transition.
- `reason` (String) Machine-readable reason for the condition's last transition.
- `status` (String) Condition status (True, False, Unknown).
- `type` (String) Condition type (e.g. Ready, Initialized, ContainersReady, PodScheduled).
